test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_unequal_row_groups.parquet', Parquet) SELECT number AS a, number * 3 AS b FROM numbers(64 * 1500000) WHERE number % 1500000 < if(intDiv(number, 1500000) % 2 = 0, 1500000, 500000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_block_size = 1500000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 1000000000, output_format_parquet_row_group_size_bytes = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT sum(sipHash64(a, b)) FROM file('test_unequal_row_groups.parquet') FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_unequal_row_groups.parquet') WHERE sipHash64(a) % 3 = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(cityHash64(repeat(toString(b), 300))) FROM file('test_unequal_row_groups.parquet') WHERE a < 3000000 SETTINGS max_threads = 8 FORMAT Null
